history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration take measures to further improve the indicators in the senior managers’ compacts and consider the alignment of the compacts’ key performance indicators with the delegation of authority key performance indicators, so as to strengthen the effectiveness of senior managers’ compacts as instruments of accountability.
history.administration_response: The Administration considers this recommendation implemented and requests its closure. The Administration completed a comprehensive revision of the template used for compacts for 2022. The third section thereof, on managing resources, contains common performance measures in the areas of human resources, financial resources, ICT, and internal controls and oversight. It incorporates the following new or strengthened quantitative indicators; two new indicators on Board recommendations, four new indicators on effective financial resource management, a defined quantitative methodology for casualty evacuations indicator, a defined quantitative methodology for integration indicator, and the enhancement of the quantitative methodology for timely recruitment indicator. The revised template includes commitments to using the delegated authorities to implement mandates effectively and accountably and to operating an effective system of delegation of authority. During the revision exercise, the Monitoring and Evaluation Service of the Business Transformation and Accountability Division conducted an analysis to ensure that the underlying indicators were aligned with the delegation of authority key performance indicators. The exercise was performed on the understanding that the underlying data can be measured in different ways for different business needs.
history.board_assessment: Given that the template for the compacts for 2022 has been finalized and the Administration has conducted a comprehensive revision of the template, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
